description: This file defines the SurrogateCodec class, which is a generic serializer and copier framework for types using surrogates and converters, mainly in the context of Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: SurrogateCodec
classes.description: A generic serializer and copier that uses surrogates and converters for serialization in Orleans, supporting deep copying, reading, and writing of complex types.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the input object, utilizing surrogate conversion and copier, with caching in the context.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the serialized data, handling references and surrogate deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField to the writer, handling reference tracking and surrogate conversion.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a TField object using the surrogate serializer and converter.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Populates a TField object by deserializing surrogate data and using the populator.

methods.name: DeepCopy (interface implementation)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input using surrogate conversion and copiers, then populates the output.
